[34mInvestigated:[0m The same-origin spec in test/same-origin.test.ts, including its header, case groups, and five open todos. The existing parseURL in src/parse.ts, which returns an empty host for blob, data, javascript, and vbscript and flags scheme-less input with a protocolRelative symbol. The header of src/utils.ts and the export chain from src/index.ts.

[33mLearned:[0m parseURL already returns an empty protocol for "//" inputs, so the scheme check alone rejects protocol-relative input. Opaque schemes come back with an empty host, so they must be excluded explicitly. Default-port equivalence is scheme-specific: https://example.com:80 must stay distinct from https://example.com. The earlier 51 suite failures came entirely from the unimplemented isSameOrigin import.

[32mCompleted:[0m isSameOrigin(a, b) is implemented in src/utils.ts, using a getOrigin helper and a DEFAULT_PORTS map for http, https, ws, wss, and ftp. It is re-exported through src/index.ts. The same-origin spec was rewritten to default-port equivalence, with cross-scheme defaults kept distinct. The full vitest run passes 14 of 14 files, with 547 tests passing and 5 todo. The tsc and eslint runs produced no captured output. Nothing is committed.

[35mNext Steps:[0m Decide whether joinRelativeURL should get the same query and hash ordering fix that joinURL received. Resolve the five todo semantics: blob origins, punycode equivalence, trailing-dot FQDN, whitespace trimming, and an optional base argument. Split the staging if joinURL and isSameOrigin should land as separate commits, since both are in src/utils.ts and test/same-origin.test.ts is untracked.

[36mNotes:[0m Confirm tsc and eslint explicitly, since their output was not captured. The getOrigin protocol guard was simplified to rely on parseURL's empty protocol for scheme-less input, so the same-origin spec's protocol-relative cases are the regression check for that choice.
